options.opa: The infection caused by Zika virus can be associated with Guillain Barré syndrome.
options.opb: The Ebola virus can be transmitted sexually.
options.opc: Chikungunya virus infection can produce arthritis and arthralgia that can last several months.
options.opd: Anopheles is a vector that can transmit Zika, Chikunguña or Dengue.
